# Red-tailed Hawk — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the scientific name of the Red-tailed Hawk?", "Buteo jamaicensis"),
    ("What does the Red-tailed Hawk eat?", "rodents"),
    ("What is scientific name?", "Buteo jamaicensis"),
    ("What is size?", "55 cm"),
    ("What is habitat?", "North America"),
    ("What is diet?", "rodents"),
    ("What is range?", "Americas"),
    ("What is notable?", "The classic roadside raptor cry"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
